crossRefs.note: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard…
Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any…
I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has…
The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out…
